## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `status` line shortens the revision differently from `history` and `completed`, even though its docstring says it uses the same identifier. Fix the slice before merging. Nothing else passed the finding gates.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — `status` uses `revision[:7]`, but `history` and `completed` use `revision[:12]` (`app/display.py:5`, `app/display.py:9`). The docstring at line 13 says it shows "the deployment revision using the same identifier as history", so the code contradicts it. For the test fixture `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status` returns `Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)` while `history` returns `History: 0123456789ab`. The new test only checks the `Running: ` prefix and the `(attempt 2)` suffix, so it doesn't catch this. Could you change the slice to `revision[:12]` and make the test assert the full string, `"Running: 0123456789ab (attempt 2)"`? — Users can't match a running deployment's status line to its history or completion entry by revision, and a 7-character prefix is more likely to be ambiguous between revisions than the 12-character one used elsewhere.
